name: Comparative gene neighborhoods, fusions and presence profiles
description: Expose gene-order, strand, fusion and component-presence observations across explicitly selected genomes and proteins; count only defined records and retain unknown or incomplete context.

capability_operations.operation: Acquire and inspect selected genome features

inputs.selector: locus tag, protein ID or coordinate with coordinate frame

outputs.features: native labels, coordinates, strands and partial-boundary markers; source assertions preserved

capability_operations.invocation_note: Normalized capability contract; the confirmed callable list identifies existing related primitives only, not interchangeable signatures.

inputs.cells: reported or search-derived presence/absence/unknown with method and completeness

outputs.counts: selected-row counts and intersections; unknown not coerced to absent

capability_operations.invocation_note: Normalized capability contract; the confirmed callable list identifies existing related primitives only, not interchangeable signatures.

capability_operations.operation: Build a new comparative profile or gene tree

inputs.tree_model: explicit alignment, substitution and support settings if used

outputs.candidate_tree: topology and support with exact method

capability_operations.invocation_note: Normalized capability contract; the confirmed callable list identifies existing related primitives only, not interchangeable signatures.

research_operations_performed: context/oarx-profile-probe.json and oarx_actual_routes.json: exact published component rows and CP022614.1 CDS/regulatory coordinates inspected; no full phylogenetic reconstruction.
chemistry/raw/bcd_genome_probe_summary.json: published subunit identities checked against a current genome record; supports identity, not a second biochemical causal route.
capability_specifications_not_confirmed_: New cross-genome profile assembly, fusion detection and phylogenetic inference need explicit data and implementations; the catalog does not establish a turnkey comparative-genomics agent.
author_experiments_are_source_evidence_o: Knockout growth, product reconstitution and substrate tests used to validate profile suggestions are author experiments.
availability.binding_limit: A repository catalog definition is confirmed source-code identity, not proof of caller enablement, service availability, installed dependencies or execution in this research. Research scripts are retained operations, not registered runtime tools.

limits: Blank source cells can be unknown; native missing genes require the actual search/completeness scope.
Gene adjacency supports association, not the specific catalytic reaction, donor, order or universal requirement.
Source taxon/strain and experimental strain must retain separate identities.

observed_uses.use: The actual OarX/FmnO profile and selected neighborhoods limited a universal paired-enzyme hypothesis.
observed_uses.execution_scope: 87 published rows were counted; no de-novo genome survey or native activity assignment.

observed_uses.use: Cross-organism neighborhoods separated two GHMP-like paralogs and pathway-bearing from pathway-lacking comparisons.
observed_uses.execution_scope: Authors genome analysis; historical WIT IDs retained without invented modern mappings.

observed_uses.use: EF-P residue/component distribution and paralog neighborhoods tied YjeK to EF-P modification rather than the catabolic LAM partner.
observed_uses.execution_scope: Context did not decide the two possible chemical orders; later author substrate tests did.

observed_uses.use: Inverse QueG/DUF208 distribution, pathway neighborhoods and QueA fusions exposed replacement candidates.
observed_uses.execution_scope: Published comparative profiles and cellular rescue; purified productive QueH reaction remained unestablished.

observed_uses.use: Only a subset of BioY neighborhoods link BioMN, motivating optional-module distinctions.
observed_uses.execution_scope: Authors transport kinetics, not module counts, established affinity effects.

observed_uses.execution_scope: The ADP dependence was author biochemical evidence, not an implication of fusion.
